It truly pains me to write this as I have genuinely always had a great experience with Gymshark, but unfortunately this experience took me there!!

Treating paying customers who provide full transparency like criminals is unacceptable. Unbelievably lazy and automated customer service. Come on Gymshark you must do better as this is not how you retain repeat customers.


Response to Shaz,

Shaz, if you actually read my public review, you would see that my order number is already provided right there. 

I have already done your team's job for them by sending a detailed email thread with full screenshot documentation proving that the USPS parcel lockers have been completely out of order and closed for over 16 days, making physical delivery of my package impossible. 

Your public reply here pretends to want to help, but behind the scenes, your customer service is completely flawed, rigid and just plain broken. I just received an email from a person named Molly who explicitly stated that your team "is unable to investigate further with the courier" or process my refund unless I sign a rigid declaration form. 

Instead of a human reviewing my tracking history and the clear facility outage screenshots I provided, your team is holding any form of resolution behind automated forms and legal scripts. I am done running in circles and repeating information I have already provided multiple times. Look up my existing support ticket history under my order number and please reissue my missing order. Your issue is with the courier service you contracted with not me I am just the consumer of a product that your courier failed to deliver. I am not requesting a refund just a company who values their customers and does the right thing.

Considering 2,808 reviews, most reviewers were somewhat happy with their experience overall. Consumers frequently mention that the online purchasing platform is very easy to navigate and the apparel quality feels consistently great across different clothing items. People also deeply appreciate when friendly customer support teams resolve shipping issues or incorrect deliveries promptly and efficiently without any unnecessary hassle.

Some reviewers were not happy with packages getting lost during transit, causing lengthy delivery delays, poor tracking updates, and missed expectations. Customers additionally experienced frustrating hurdles when trying to process returns, communicate with unhelpful automated bots, or secure proper refunds for faulty goods.

topicAiSummaries.summary: Consumers find product experiences to be a mixed bag, reflecting deep divisions in opinion. On one hand, many reviewers praise the stylish appearance, lovely materials, and comfortable fit of their clothing. On the other hand, a significant number of shoppers report receiving damaged items, poor durability, and incorrect sizing or missing pieces.

Reviewers highlight ambiguous experiences regarding their orders, as many customers report missing items, lost packages, and delayed deliveries. However, others praise the fast shipping times, quick customer support resolutions, and overall satisfaction with previous purchases.

Customers consistently note ambiguous experiences with customer service, reflecting a wide split in satisfaction levels. On one hand, some reviewers praise the fast response times, friendly agents, and quick resolution of delivery or damaged items. Conversely, other consumers report extreme frustration, citing unhelpful automated bots, delayed replies, and unresolved complaints after weeks of contact.

Clients share ambiguous opinions on delivery service, reflecting a mix of positive and negative experiences. While some reviewers praised fast shipping and quick resolutions for lost parcels, others reported severe delays, lost shipments, and unhelpful support.

Customers had ambiguous experiences with quality. While many reviewers praised the comfortable fit and top quality of the clothing, others expressed disappointment over items developing holes, tears, or fabric bobbling after only a few wears. Additionally, some people reported receiving damaged, dirty, or see-through products, leading to mixed overall sentiment regarding the high prices.
